hints.title: Subtract the overlapping sums
hints.body: The first five terms occur in both partial sums. Subtract the equal sums and identify the consecutive terms left over.
hints.recap: Subtracting two partial sums isolates an arithmetic block.
hints.pitfall: The sixth term uses five common differences after the first term.
hints.pause: Write those remaining terms in terms of the first term and common difference, then simplify the equality.

recall.reminder: Subtracting two partial sums isolates an arithmetic block.

solution:
1. Isolate the extra terms. S8−S5=u6+u7+u8=0.

2. Write the arithmetic terms. (a+5d)+(a+6d)+(a+7d)=0, so 3a+18d=0.

3. Rearrange. a=−6d. This also holds when d=0, when all terms are zero. Answer C.
knowledgePattern: Subtract equal AP partial sums to isolate a zero-sum block
